description: Inflation calculator, CPI inflation adjustment for US dollars. Adjust a US dollar amount for inflation between two months or years with the official CPI-U (all items, US city average) from the Bureau of Labor Statistics: the equivalent amount, cumulative inflation %, the CPI values used and the latest 12-month inflation rate. Public US government data. Price: $0.002 per call (x402, USDC on Base).
name: us_inflation
